observations: Retail packaging for a 'JBL CHARGE 6' portable speaker.
The speaker depicted on the box features a carrying strap and a non-standard JBL logo with a red outline.
Box text indicates 'Bluetooth V5.4' and '28H' battery life.
A watermark 'ONPLUS COMMUNICATION' is visible across the image.
Only the front of the box is shown; the actual speaker is not visible.

claims.evidence: JBL has not released a 'Charge 6' model; the current official model in this series is the Charge 5. The design shown does not match any genuine JBL product.

claims.claim: It offers JBL Pro Sound with AI Sound Boost

risks.proof: Official manufacturer product catalog showing no such model exists.

risks.risk: The box may be empty or the item inside may be damaged.
risks.proof: A video of the speaker being removed from the box and turned on.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual speaker outside of the box.
Photo of the serial number and manufacturer information on the bottom of the speaker.
Video of the speaker pairing with a phone and playing music.
response.reason: The 'JBL Charge 6' is a well-known counterfeit model; JBL has no such product in its lineup. The packaging design and features (like the strap and logo font) are inconsistent with genuine JBL merchandise.
